name: sp4sap
description: SuperPlugin for SAP — SAP ABAP development for Codex. Connects to SAP On-Premise S/4HANA over the abap-mcp-adt MCP server (150+ ADT tools) with Dev/QA/Prod write protection, 25 SAP-specialized agents, and 14 workflow skills.

interface.shortDescription: SAP ABAP development with live S/4HANA connectivity
interface.longDescription: Create, read, change and activate ABAP objects — classes, programs, function modules, CDS views, RAP business objects — directly on an SAP On-Premise S/4HANA system through the abap-mcp-adt MCP server. Includes Dev/QA/Prod tier write protection, transport management, ATC/unit-test runs, SPRO configuration reference for 14 modules, and 25 SAP-specialized agent roles.
defaultPrompt: Read ABAP class ZCL_EXAMPLE and summarize what it does.
Create an ALV report for open purchase orders by vendor.
Run ATC on package ZSD_ORDER and list the findings.
